unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: 7-mashqdagi tushib qolgan vaqtlar AUDIO orqali beriladi. Audio yo'q — vaqtlar matn mantiqidan va mashqning o'z savollaridan (masalan 'What time do restaurants open for dinner?') chiqarilgan, har birining sababi whyUz da. 8-mashqda rasmga sifat moslash ham rasmdagi yuz ifodasiga qarab aniqlangan.

sections.title: Reading & Listening — Welcome to Holland
sections.titleUz: O'qish va tinglash — Gollandiyaga xush kelibsiz

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text, then listen and fill in the missing times.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, tushib qolgan vaqtlarni yozing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Audiosiz vaqtlarni mashqning savollaridan va matn mantiqidan topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — Gollandiyadagi ish vaqtlari haqida sayyohlar uchun ma'lumot.

TO'RT BO'LIM:
  Shops              — do'konlar
  Banks and Post Offices — banklar va pochta bo'limlari
  Chemists           — dorixonalar
  Restaurants        — restoranlar

VAQT PREDLOGLARI (bu matndagi asosiy grammatika):
  FROM ... UNTIL ... — ...dan ...gacha
  ON Saturday        — shanba kuni
  Monday TO Friday   — dushanbadan jumagacha

AM va PM:
  am — tushdan OLDIN (00:00–11:59)
  pm — tushdan KEYIN (12:00–23:59)
  noon — tush payti, soat 12:00

lines.textEn: Shops are open Monday to Friday from 9 am until a) ____ pm, ...
lines.hintUz: Do'konlar odatda kechqurun soat nechada yopiladi?
lines.whyUz: Yevropada do'konlar odatda 18:00 (6 pm) da yopiladi. 'Late-night shopping' payshanba va jumaga alohida aytilgan — demak boshqa kunlari oddiy vaqt.

lines.textEn: ... and on Saturday from 9 am until 4 or b) ____ pm.
lines.whyUz: Matnda '4 or ...' — demak keyingi soat, ya'ni 5. Shanbada do'konlar ertaroq yopiladi.

lines.textEn: Many places have late-night shopping on Thursday or Friday evenings.
lines.uz: Ko'p joylarda payshanba yoki juma kechqurunlari kech xarid qilish mumkin.

lines.textEn: Banks are open Monday to Friday from c) ____ am until 5 pm ...
lines.hintUz: Banklar odatda ertalab soat nechada ochiladi?
lines.whyUz: Banklar odatda 9:00 da ochiladi — do'konlar bilan bir xil.

lines.textEn: ... and sometimes later on Thursday or Friday.
lines.uz: ...va ba'zan payshanba yoki juma kuni kechroq.

lines.textEn: Post offices are open Monday to Friday from 8:30 am until d) ____ pm, ...
lines.hintUz: Pochta bo'limlari kechqurun soat nechada yopiladi?
lines.whyUz: Pochta bo'limlari banklar bilan bir xil — 17:00 (5 pm) da yopiladi.

lines.textEn: ... and often on Saturday from 8:30 am until noon.
Chemists are open Monday to Friday from 8 am until e) ____ pm.
lines.whyUz: Dorixonalar do'konlar bilan bir xil — 18:00 (6 pm). Ular ertaroq (8:00) ochiladi.

lines.textEn: Some chemists stay open to cover evenings, nights and weekends.
lines.uz: Ba'zi dorixonalar kechqurun, tunda va dam olish kunlarida ham ochiq turadi.

lines.textEn: Restaurants are generally open for lunch from f) ____ am until 3 pm ...
lines.whyUz: Tushlik tush paytida — 12:00 dan boshlanadi. Matnda 'am' yozilgan, demak 12 am (tush payti).

lines.textEn: ... and for dinner from g) ____ until 10 pm.
lines.hintUz: Kechki ovqat soat nechada boshlanadi? (5-savolga qarang)
lines.whyUz: 5-savol aynan shuni so'raydi. Yevropada kechki ovqat 18:00 (6 pm) dan boshlanadi.

lines.textEn: The Dutch are not late diners, but there are some restaurants which stay open late in the big cities.
lines.uz: Gollandiyaliklar kech ovqatlanmaydi, lekin katta shaharlarda kech ochiq turadigan restoranlar bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and answer the following questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLARDA DIQQAT QILING:

  'What time do shops CLOSE?' — YOPILISH vaqti (until ...)
  'What time do chemists OPEN?' — OCHILISH vaqti (from ...)

  'on Tuesday' — seshanba 'Monday to Friday' ichiga kiradi,
  demak oddiy ish kuni vaqti.

  'Which day ...?' — QAYSI KUN? Javob kun nomi bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 1  What time do shops close on Saturday?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'on Saturday from 9 am until 4 or 5 pm'. 'close' = yopilish, ya'ni 'until' dan keyingi vaqt.

items.textEn: 2  What time do banks close on Tuesday?
items.whyUz: Seshanba 'Monday to Friday' ichida. Matnda: 'until 5 pm'. Kechroq faqat payshanba va jumada.

items.textEn: 3  Which day do post offices open from 8:30 until noon?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'often on Saturday from 8:30 am until noon'. 'noon' = tush, soat 12.

items.textEn: 4  What time do chemists open on Tuesday?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'Monday to Friday from 8 am'. 'open' = ochilish, ya'ni 'from' dan keyingi vaqt.

items.textEn: 5  What time do restaurants open for dinner?
6  Are there any restaurants in Holland which stay open late?
items.answer: Yes, there are. There are some restaurants which stay open late in the big cities.
items.whyUz: Ha/yo'q savoli → qisqa javob + to'liq gap. 'stay open' = ochiq qolmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a text similar to the one in Ex. 7 about the opening hours of shops and restaurants in your country.
exercises.instructionUz: 7-mashqdagiga o'xshash matn yozing — o'z mamlakatingizdagi do'kon va restoranlarning ish vaqti haqida.
exercises.explanationUz:
TUZILISHI (7-mashqdagi kabi):
  Sarlavha: Welcome to ... (mamlakatingiz nomi)
  Shops
  Banks and Post Offices
  Chemists
  Restaurants

KERAKLI QOLIPLAR:
  ... are open + kun(lar) + FROM ... UNTIL ...
  Some ... stay open ...
  Many places have ...

O'ZBEKISTON UCHUN namuna quyida berilgan.
O'z shahringizdagi haqiqiy vaqtlarni yozing.

structure.modelEn: Shops are open Monday to Saturday from 9 am until 8 pm.
On Sunday many shops are open from 10 am until 6 pm.
Banks are open Monday to Friday from 9 am until 5 pm.
Post offices are open Monday to Saturday from 9 am until 6 pm.
Chemists are open every day from 8 am until 10 pm. Some chemists stay open all night.
Restaurants are generally open for lunch from 12 am until 4 pm.
They are open for dinner from 6 pm until 11 pm.
There are also some restaurants which stay open late in the big cities.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the pictures with the adjectives in the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: happy, tired, stressed, satisfied, bored

BESHTA HIS-TUYG'U:
  happy     — baxtli, xursand
  tired     — charchagan
  stressed  — asabiy, siqilgan
  satisfied — mamnun, qoniqqan
  bored     — zerikkan

HAMMASI -ED bilan tugaydi (happy dan tashqari) —
chunki ular ODAM his qilgan holatni bildiradi.

ESLATMA (Unit 5, 34-bet):
  -ed → ODAM his qiladi:  I am bored. (zerikkanman)
  -ing → NARSA shunday:   The film is boring. (film zerikarli)

exercises.instructionEn: Match the adjectives to the reasons. Make sentences joining them with because, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni sabablarga moslang. 'because' bilan qo'shib gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA (kitobda strelka bilan ko'rsatilgan):
  I feel happy because I enjoy my work.

QOLIP:
  I feel + SIFAT + because + SABAB.

SABABLAR:
  I enjoy my work.              — ishimdan zavqlanaman
  I work long hours.            — ko'p soat ishlayman
  I earn a lot of money.        — ko'p pul topaman
  I talk to angry customers.    — jahldor mijozlar bilan gaplashaman
  I do the same things every day. — har kuni bir xil ish qilaman

MANTIQ BILAN MOSLANG:
  ko'p ishlash    → charchash (tired)
  jahldor mijoz   → asabiylashish (stressed)
  bir xil ish     → zerikish (bored)
  ko'p pul        → mamnunlik (satisfied)
  zavq            → baxt (happy)

'feel' dan keyin SIFAT keladi (ravish emas):
  ✅ I feel happy.   ❌ I feel happily.

example.uz: O'zimni baxtli his qilaman, chunki ishimdan zavqlanaman.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Ish vaqti va his-tuyg'ular haqida gapirish.

patterns.formula: X are open + kun(lar) + FROM + vaqt + UNTIL + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: Shops are open Monday to Friday from 9 am until 6 pm.
patterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar dushanbadan jumagacha ertalab 9 dan kechqurun 6 gacha ochiq.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ish vaqtini aytishning standart qolipi.
Kun oralig'i uchun 'to', vaqt oralig'i uchun 'from ... until ...'.

patterns.formula: ON + kun + FROM + vaqt + UNTIL + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: On Saturday from 9 am until 4 or 5 pm.
patterns.exampleUz: Shanba kuni ertalab 9 dan kunduzi 4 yoki 5 gacha.

patterns.formula: What time do + ko'plik ega + open/close?
patterns.exampleEn: What time do shops close on Saturday? — They close at 4 or 5 pm.
patterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar shanba kuni soat nechada yopiladi? — Soat 4 yoki 5 da.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bilan DO. Javobda soat oldida AT.

patterns.exampleEn: Some chemists stay open to cover evenings, nights and weekends.
patterns.exampleUz: Ba'zi dorixonalar kechqurun, tunda va dam olish kunlarida ochiq turadi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'stay open' = ochiq qolmoq. 'stay' dan keyin sifat keladi.

patterns.formula: There are some X WHICH + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: There are some restaurants which stay open late in the big cities.
patterns.exampleUz: Katta shaharlarda kech ochiq turadigan restoranlar bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'which' — NARSA uchun bog'lovchi ('who' — odam uchun).
O'zbekchada '-adigan' qo'shimchasi.

patterns.exampleEn: I feel happy because I enjoy my work.
patterns.exampleUz: O'zimni baxtli his qilaman, chunki ishimdan zavqlanaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'feel' dan keyin SIFAT (ravish emas).
'because' bilan sabab — bu mashqning asosiy maqsadi.
